steps: 2. READ D:\Mart Project\.agents\tasks\health-audit-fix-plan.md for the exact code for every item below.

3. 8. Run python -m py_compile on every file edited in this FEAT. All must exit 0.
9. Set FEAT-003.status to 'completed' and record any deviations in findings.
